title: Samplesheet schema
description: One row per sequencing unit: paired FASTQs, optional truth set and optional seeded downsampling. Paths may be absolute, s3://, or relative to the samplesheet.

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must be 1-64 chars of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (no spaces)

individual.errorMessage: individual must be 1-64 chars of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'
individual.description: Biological sample (read-group SM). Defaults to `sample`; lets several rows (e.g. downsampling replicates) share one individual.

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1 must be a gzipped FASTQ (.fq.gz / .fastq.gz) with no spaces

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2 must be a gzipped FASTQ (.fq.gz / .fastq.gz) with no spaces

truth_vcf.errorMessage: truth_vcf must be a bgzipped VCF (.vcf.gz) with a .tbi next to it

downsample.errorMessage: downsample must be a fraction in (0, 1]
downsample.description: Fraction of read pairs to keep (seqtk sample).

seed.errorMessage: seed must be a non-negative integer
